amenitiesDescription:
The Shore Club Private Collection delivers the rare combination of boutique residential privacy and full five-star hotel service, curated by Auberge Resorts Collection. Residential amenities include lap, leisure, and private pools set in botanical gardens; a world-class spa and beauty atelier; a private residential gym with personal training suites; a residents' beach club with cabana service; library lounge; children's playroom; and a private dining and meeting suite. Residents also receive a Social Membership to the Shell Bay Club, with access to its Racquet Club, Yacht Club, and restaurants.

Building services cover 24-hour concierge and reception, a dedicated Director of Residences, in-residence butler, housekeeping, dining and catering, spa treatments, valet, laundry, and dry-cleaning. The Auberge food and beverage program adds signature restaurants, poolside dining, a cocktail lounge with grand piano, and a beachside beach club — all steps from your front door.

signals.title: $97M phased construction permit (August 2026)
signals.body: Miami Beach issued the week's largest new-building permit for Shore Club's 481,200 SF tower at 1901 Collins. Job filing BC2322278 advances Witkoff and Monroe Capital's active build toward 2027 delivery.

signals.title: Robert A.M. Stern's first oceanfront residential project
signals.body: RAMSA designed 15 Central Park West, 220 Central Park South, and 520 Park Avenue in New York. The Shore Club is their first oceanfront residential tower, with Stern handling both architecture and interiors in one unified vision.

signals.title: Surpassed the 2015 Faena House record
signals.body: The flagship penthouse contract surpassed Ken Griffin's $60M Faena House purchase from 2015 — a step-change that signals the depth of demand for top-tier oceanfront product.

signals.title: Auberge Resorts Collection — boutique five-star management
signals.body: Auberge operates some of the most exclusive resort properties in the world (Chileno Bay, Esperanza, Stanly Ranch). Residents receive Auberge's full residential services plus a complimentary Shell Bay Golf Club social membership — a Greg Norman-designed championship club with marina, racquet club, and spa.

signals.title: 49 residences, no two floor plans alike
signals.body: The Shore Club spans a 20-story tower, Cromwell House with four historic residences, and a 6,000 SF beach house. At 49 homes on three oceanfront acres, density ranks among Miami Beach's lowest, with no future supply on this Collins stretch.

investmentThesis: 90%+ sold with very limited inventory remaining. Miami Beach issued a $97 million phased new-construction permit in early August 2026 for 481,200 SF at 1901 Collins (job BC2322278), advancing Witkoff and Monroe Capital's build against the existing $430M J.P. Morgan construction loan. RAMSA's first oceanfront residential project (the firm behind 15 Central Park West and 220 Central Park South) applies its classical residential language to Miami Beach for the first time. Auberge Resorts Collection manages the hotel and residential services, extending the standard set at Esperanza, Chileno Bay, and Goldfield to one of South Beach's most storied addresses. The Shore Club site at 19th and Collins has been a cultural landmark since the 1950s, and the development represents one of the largest oceanfront restoration projects on Collins Avenue in a generation. Every purchaser receives a Social Membership to Shell Bay Club with access to its Racquet Club, Yacht Club, and restaurants, extending the ownership package well beyond the residence itself.
name: Shore Club Private Collection
residenceContent: A reborn oceanfront landmark at 1901 Collins Avenue, with architecture and interiors unified under a single Robert A.M. Stern vision. Three distinct residential offerings: The Tower (18 stories, 2- to 6-bedroom homes from approximately 1,900 to over 10,000 SF), the historic Cromwell House (4 residences including duplex homes and a full-floor penthouse), and The Beach House (a singular 4-bedroom oceanfront residence with private garage and over 2,180 SF of outdoor living). Every home enters through a private residential lobby on 20th Street, separating owners from hotel guests. Finishes include wide-plank European oak floors, custom millwork, Gaggenau appliances, and natural stone throughout. The Tower's flow-through layouts capture both Atlantic and city exposures; lower-floor residences open onto landscaped terraces directly above the historic Shore Club gardens.
